description: This file is a CMake module, specifically a script containing functions, macros, and documentation related to CUDA and NVIDIA GPU support within CMake. It provides mechanisms to locate CUDA libraries, compile CUDA sources, and generate necessary build steps for integrating CUDA code into CMake projects.

methods.name: CUDA_FIND_HELPER_FILE
methods.description: Locates specific helper files in the FindCUDA directory, caches their paths for later use.

methods.name: CUDA_INCLUDE_NVCC_DEPENDENCIES
methods.description: Includes dependency files for NVCC source code, regenerates dependencies if headers are missing.

methods.name: cuda_unset_include_and_libraries
methods.description: Unsets internal CUDA-related cache variables to force re-detection.

methods.name: CUDA_GET_SOURCES_AND_OPTIONS
methods.description: Parses source files and options from macro arguments, separating options from source files.

methods.name: CUDA_PARSE_NVCC_OPTIONS
methods.description: Parses NVCC-specific options from macro arguments, supporting per-configuration flags.

methods.name: CUDA_ADD_CUDA_INCLUDE_ONCE
methods.description: Adds CUDA include directories only once to prevent duplication.

methods.name: CUDA_BUILD_SHARED_LIBRARY
methods.description: Determines whether to build shared, static, or module libraries based on arguments and build settings.

methods.name: CUDA_COMPUTE_BUILD_PATH
methods.description: Generates a unique build path for source files to avoid filename clashes in build artifacts.

methods.name: CUDA_WRAP_SRCS
methods.description: Main macro that generates build commands for CUDA source files, supporting formats like OBJ, PTX, CUBIN, FATBIN, handling dependencies and compilation flags.

methods.name: CUDA_GET_IMPORTANT_HOST_FLAGS
methods.description: Extracts important host compiler flags based on the generator or compiler type.

methods.name: CUDA_COMPUTE_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION_OBJECT_FILE_NAME
methods.description: Computes a filename for intermediate link files used in separable compilation, based on target and object files.

methods.name: CUDA_LINK_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION_OBJECTS
methods.description: Sets up build rules for intermediate link objects used in separable compilation.

methods.name: CUDA_ADD_LIBRARY
methods.description: Macro to add a CUDA library target, managing source handling, compilation, and linking.

methods.name: CUDA_ADD_EXECUTABLE
methods.description: Macro to add a CUDA executable target, managing source handling, compilation, and linking.

methods.name: cuda_compile_base
methods.description: Internal helper macro for compiling CUDA sources with specific formats, creating custom targets.

methods.name: CUDA_COMPILE
methods.description: Macro to compile CUDA sources into object files, using cuda_compile_base.

methods.name: CUDA_COMPILE_PTX
methods.description: Macro to compile CUDA sources into PTX format.

methods.name: CUDA_COMPILE_FATBIN
methods.description: Macro to compile CUDA sources into FATBIN format.

methods.name: CUDA_COMPILE_CUBIN
methods.description: Macro to compile CUDA sources into CUBIN format.

methods.name: CUDA_ADD_CUFFT_TO_TARGET
methods.description: Adds cuFFT library to a target, handling emulation and real libraries.

methods.name: CUDA_ADD_CUBLAS_TO_TARGET
methods.description: Adds cuBLAS library to a target, handling emulation and real libraries.

methods.name: CUDA_BUILD_CLEAN_TARGET
methods.description: Creates a clean target for CUDA build artifacts, facilitating cleanup of intermediate files.
